verdict.rationale: Trivy is not itself an AI agent but a security scanning tool, and it ships an official trivy-mcp server (aquasecurity/trivy-mcp) that starts an MCP server integrating Trivy's scanning with VS Code and other MCP-enabled tools, including natural language querying. This is corroborated by both docs and a dedicated probe confirming the official repo. missing for 10: independent/hands-on community validation of the MCP server's reliability and no mention of broader IDE/agent compatibility beyond VS Code.
